inputs.global_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single adult subject represented by <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>; the images provide complementary front and rear appearance, clothing, proportions and material references.

summary:
[reference generation] A short natural studio shot of <Subject 1>, preserving the referenced appearance while allowing subtle body and camera movement.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the recognizable identity, proportions, clothing design and material colors shown by the reference images.

detailed_description:
The target video uses realistic CG rendering with soft neutral studio illumination and a plain grey background.
[Shot 1] One medium-wide continuous shot shows <Subject 1> in a frontal three-quarter view. The subject remains centered, fully visible from head to footwear with comfortable space around the silhouette. The face, hairstyle, clothing layers, fastenings and small accessories follow the complementary front and rear evidence in the two reference images. Existing asymmetries stay attached to the same side of the body; decorative details do not migrate between shoulders or sleeves. No additional person, prop or costume element appears.
At the opening the subject holds a comfortable balanced standing pose. Their weight shifts subtly over the supporting foot while the other foot remains in contact with the floor. The torso follows the shift with a small natural counter-rotation. The head turns slightly in the same continuous motion and then settles, with a single restrained blink if the face is visible. The movement is modest enough to keep the original overall pose and proportions legible. Hands remain distinct and fingers retain a relaxed consistent arrangement rather than merging with nearby clothing. There is no rapid gesture or change of outfit.
The camera trucks left with small amplitude at slow speed, showing a gentle change in parallax while retaining the same shot scale. The floor contact and background remain stable. The material response changes naturally with the view: cloth keeps broad soft highlights and fine folds, rigid decorative parts keep coherent edges, and hair moves only slightly with the subject. Soft shadows follow the same light direction throughout, without flickering, exposure pumping or a new dramatic light source.
The final part of the shot eases smoothly into a still balanced pose. Silhouette, framing and identity remain recognizable. The scene contains no captions, logos, graphical overlays or contact sheet. Subtle fabric movement and the soft shift of footwear on the floor are synchronized with the visible motion; the subject does not speak. This is a newly generated shot guided by the reference appearance, not a copy of either image as a mandatory first or last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet studio room tone with faint fabric movement and a soft footwear scuff, no speech.
